title: Reader reply batching
impact: Batching stream re-query replies reduced the exp 136 completion counter in a profile smoke (A11c overlap completion callbacks 4,527 → 1,425, completion wall 109.6 ms → 55.6 ms), but the formal Tracelite stream-dispatch A/B did not produce a measured-elapsed win. High-cardinality fanout changed +5.18%, many-streams writer throughput +3.28%, and keyed-PK subscriptions +13.5%. Do not merge worker-side reader-reply batching without a workload that turns the callback reduction into end-to-end wall improvement.
